facts.text: Sandy Lane's accommodations are in a Neo-Palladian style.
facts.excerpt: Neo-Palladian accommodations are appointed with rich furniture, and offer views of the beachfront or Sandy Lane’s tropical gardens.

facts.text: The resort stands on the site of a onetime sugar plantation.
facts.excerpt: The resort, on the site of a onetime sugar plantation, offers old-school Caribbean luxury.

facts.text: Accommodation ranges from guest rooms and suites to penthouses and a five-bedroom villa.
facts.excerpt: Our sumptuous guest rooms, suites, penthouses and 5-bedroom villa feature lush gardens, spectacular views and a true sense of privacy.

facts.text: The Ocean Rooms are beachfront rooms so close to the sea that guests can step out of the room and stroll to the water and sand.
facts.excerpt: These magnificent beachfront rooms in the Caribbean are so close to the sea that you can step out of your room and stroll to the warm waters and white sands.

facts.text: The Sandy Lane Suite offers sunset views from a terrace infinity pool and direct access to Sandy Lane's stretch of white sand beach.
facts.excerpt: The Suite offers incredible views of sunsets from the terrace infinity pool and direct access to Sandy Lane’s exclusive stretch of white sand beach.

facts.text: The Sandy Lane Suite comes with personalised butler service.
facts.excerpt: Enhanced by personalised butler service, every detail is thoughtfully curated

facts.text: The five-bedroom Villa at Sandy Lane comes with its own Villa Butler and Villa Chef.
facts.excerpt: This magnificent 5-bedroom retreat offers an unrivaled blend of elegance and exclusivity, complete with your very own Villa Butler and Villa Chef.

facts.text: The Villa is hidden behind private gates within manicured gardens.
facts.excerpt: Hidden behind private gates and nestled within manicured gardens

facts.text: The Villa at Sandy Lane has had an extensive multi-million dollar renovation.
facts.excerpt: Following an extensive multi-million dollar renovation, The Villa at Sandy Lane has been reimagined into a stylishly iconic private residence.

facts.text: Suites in the Dolphin and Orchid wings feature Italian marble floors and plantation-style heirloom furniture.
facts.excerpt: spaciousness and comfort reign amidst Italian marbled floors and plantation-style heirloom furniture in these luxury Caribbean suites.

facts.text: The Luxury Orchid Suites have private verandas set within private gardens.
facts.excerpt: With private verandas set within impeccably manicured private gardens

facts.text: The Orchid Rooms sit in the Orchid Wing among tropical gardens, with views of island flora.
facts.excerpt: located within the resort’s Orchid Wing amidst acclaimed tropical gardens. Elegant and relaxing, these rooms afford tranquil views of island flora

facts.text: The two-bedroom Luxury Dolphin Suites are aimed at families and have private terraces with sea views.
facts.excerpt: Across the Dolphin Wing, two-bedroom Luxury Dolphin Suites offer an elegant and ideal escape for families. Offering private terraces with views of the azure sea

facts.text: The Treehouse Club for children runs activities such as sailing, outdoor movie nights and themed dinner parties.
facts.excerpt: They will be kept busy from morning until sunset with sailing, outdoor movie nights and even themed dinner parties on the itinerary.

facts.text: Teenagers have their own Den with pool tables, table football, a jukebox and a mocktail bar.
facts.excerpt: Teenagers are catered for with a special Den fitted out with pool tables, table football and a jukebox, plus a mocktail bar.

facts.text: During school holidays, children can join sports camps in swimming, water-skiing, golf, tennis and football.
facts.excerpt: Visiting during school holidays? Sign up to a sports camp and choose from swimming, water-skiing, golf, tennis and football.

facts.text: L'Acajou is an open-air restaurant serving French and Mediterranean specialties.
facts.excerpt: Dine on French and Mediterranean specialties at the open-air L’Acajou.

facts.text: Three golf courses are set along a former stone quarry and are open only to guests.
facts.excerpt: Three golf courses are set along a former stone quarry, and open only to guests.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a Caribbean home away from home.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to Sandy Lane, your Caribbean 'home away from home'...
